name: PropertySection
summary: One group of an inspector or a settings panel: its heading and the actions on the whole group on one row, then its rows. Groups sit apart by the panel's gap; nothing draws a box or a rule between them. Not for a page's sections (use Section) or for a group a person opens and closes (use Accordion).
a11y: Renders `section`, named by its heading through `aria-labelledby`. Each action is a Button with its own name ("Add fill"); an icon-only action shows its name as a tooltip.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading's level in the panel's outline.

props.name: actions
props.description: Icon buttons at the end of the heading row that act on the whole group: add one, show the sides apart, remove.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact`: the heading at the rows' own text size on a 24 px row, for xs controls in a design tool's inspector (Q68); `normal` (default) for a settings panel.

props.name: children
props.description: The group's rows. Leave it out while the group holds nothing yet: only the heading and its add action show.
